text:
The change adds batch checkout and copies orders when saving and retrieving them. The copies suit the current `Order` fields.

One blocking bug: `checkoutAll` does not await saves. I reproduced it returning a valid order’s ID before that order was stored. It also returns an empty order’s ID as placed while its save produces an unhandled rejection, which can terminate Node. The checkout contains no tests covering these cases.
